# Documentation mechanics

[WhaleIsle maintenance policy](../../../../../docs/maintenance/README.md) alone owns execution order, verification selection and delivery. This legacy skill is a navigation entry, with no word budgets, compulsory audit, approval or check chain.

Use [dsh-doc](../dsh-doc/SKILL.md) for placement, metadata, bilingual structure and website projection; use [dsh-prose-standard](../dsh-prose-standard/SKILL.md) for editorial judgment. Preserve owning product contracts and current facts. Ordinary fixes need no new decision record.

After implementation, select necessary checks for the changed scope under the host policy. Review both sides of an edited registered pair before recording its confirmation. Do not expand a local edit into a corpus audit or weaken behavior assertions to clear a check.
